summary: Iteration 6 — validated new features: hide-engineer/boot + system settings, project export/import (.nhmi), tags/ensure (direct address), and rt records/{no}/log format switch (pdf/xlsx/csv). Backend pytest: 24/24 PASS. Frontend: verified all data-testids for ServerSettingsDialog (base + conditional engineer-path/random after hide switch), ImportProjectDialog, per-card export button; verified hide-mode save flow via UI (server-save-result appears, SPA auto-redirects to /<path>/projects) and boot API mirrors it (seg=eng-uitest1 -> engineer=true, seg=projects -> engineer=false); state restored to defaults at end.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/system.py: PATH_RE allows 4-40 chars but RESERVED set includes only lowercase words; already lower-cased inbound. Consider also blocking common runtime slugs (e.g. 'public', 'files', 'uploads', 'assets') to avoid future route conflicts.

backend/transfer.py import_project: JSON round-trip via regex-based UUID_RE.sub remaps ALL UUID-like tokens including any that happen to appear in text fields (comments, labels). Very low risk but worth documenting; a targeted per-field remap would be more precise.

backend/transfer.py import_project: file size limit (300MB) is enforced only after fully reading UploadFile into memory; large payloads could pressure RAM. Consider streaming or Content-Length pre-check.
backend/server.py rt/records/{no}/log: format is validated to {pdf,xlsx,csv} but tz is not bounded; extremely large tz would still work but is inconsequential. Non-blocking.

backend/system.py write_settings coerces mdns_name via removesuffix('.local') and lowercases custom_domain before validation — good. But GET /api/system/settings returns lan_ips even in cloud mode; not a bug, useful, just note in FE that in cloud these are container-internal IPs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all spec'd data-testids present; hide-mode save+redirect confirmed)

seed_data_creation: Import test creates a temporary published copy of Demo project and deletes it in the same test class. Ensure-tag test creates an auto BOOL tag and deletes it via DELETE /api/projects/{pid}/tags/{id}. System settings toggled during UI save-flow test and restored to defaults via API (hide_engineer=false, all blanks, http_port=8080). Confirmed via /api/boot after test: {hide:false, engineer:true, default_slug:''}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public> python -m pytest backend/tests/iteration6_test.py -v -o addopts= --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration6_results.xml. Demo project 'Demo Pengolahan Air' must be published (used as default_slug candidate + as source for export/import). Chart PDF endpoint /rt/records/{no}/pdf still works and now returns chart-only (no table).
